description: Elections Commission - G. K. M. G. Thilakarathne of the Ambagamuwa Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of the United National Party -  K. Yogendran of the Maskeliya Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of United National Freedom Front - S. P. G. Dilrukshi Kumarasingha of the Rideegama Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated her office of the member Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna
reasoning: This gazette contains multiple notices under Section 10 A (1) (a) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, specifically declaring that members of various Pradeshiya Sabhas (local authorities) have vacated their offices due to ceasing membership in their respective political parties. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials in local government bodies, making it a clear fit for the Elections category (Type 7).
